name: FXRates — API on RapidAPI
description:
Get exchange rates your product can quote immediately: FXRates returns current and historical reference rates for major world currencies — one pair, or the full rate table in a single call.

What you get:
- The complete latest rate table against your chosen base currency in one response — no per-pair call fan-out
- Direct conversion results for any amount and pair, ready to display or store
- Historical rates for a specific date, for invoicing, reconciliation and back-filling reports
- A symbols endpoint listing every supported currency, so your UI and validation stay in sync with the API

Key endpoints:
- GET /latest — latest rates for all supported currencies against a base
- GET /convert — convert an amount between two currencies
- GET /historical — rates for a specific past date
- GET /symbols — list of supported currency codes

Batch / built for workflows:
FXRates is list-shaped by design: /latest returns the full currency table at once, which makes it a natural fit for scheduled rate snapshots, price-list localization jobs and finance dashboards that refresh on a timer. Rates are European Central Bank reference rates (via Frankfurter), updated on business days — the right source for accounting and display use cases.

Access: subscribe on RapidAPI (free tier available); calls are made over HTTPS with your RapidAPI key.
